storage.notes: microSD slot (SDHC/SDXC); iSCSI recording; 10 s pre-alarm RAM

features: Starlight low-light: 0.017 lx color / 0.0057 lx mono (30 IRE, F1.2)
84 dB WDR (100 dB with Intelligent Auto Exposure, IVA models)
H.264 quad-streaming plus M-JPEG; 2 Regions of Interest (E-PTZ)
Varifocal SR lens with motorized back-focus and auto-focus wizard
MOTION+ on -P models; Intelligent Video Analysis (IVA) with face detection on -IP models
Audio line in/out, full duplex; 2 alarm inputs, 1 relay output

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDN_733_Data_sheet_enUS_9736865419.pdf, V13 2016). NDN-733V09-P = 9-40 mm IR-corrected SR lens with MOTION+; NDN-733V09-IP = same camera and lens with Intelligent Video Analysis (IVA) and IAE. FOV wide 30 x 17, tele 7.1 x 3.9 (H x V). Operating temperature -50 to +55 C for non-IVA (-P), -50 to +50 C for IVA (-IP). Resolution is the largest stream (1280x1024, 30p, no IVA); 720p runs at 60 ips. Lens aperture is not given per lens in the datasheet.
